documentation: java.util.stream.Stream <-> kotlin.sequences.Sequence interop. A Stream is represented as the Sequence it came from, so the two conversions are the identity; Java Stream APIs themselves (Stream.of, collect, ...) are not modelled.

declarations.name: asSequence
declarations.documentation: Identity: a Stream is represented as a Sequence

declarations.name: asStream
declarations.documentation: Identity: the Sequence is used as the Stream
